
SHOW-DELETED
Display all soft-deleted items with IDs, text, and deletedAt timestamps for debugging and selective restoration

USAGE
  fspec show-deleted <workUnitId>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Show all deleted items with timestamps
  $ fspec show-deleted AUTH-001
  Deleted items for AUTH-001:

[1] Old business rule (deleted: 2025-01-31T12:00:00.000Z)
[3] Obsolete example (deleted: 2025-01-31T13:30:00.000Z)

Total: 2 deleted items

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec restore-rule
  fspec restore-example
  fspec restore-question
  fspec restore-architecture-note
  fspec compact-work-unit
  fspec show-work-unit

NOTES
  • Shows items with deleted: true flag
  • Displays stable IDs that can be used with restore commands
  • Shows deletedAt timestamps in ISO 8601 format
  • Useful for debugging and selective restoration
  • Returns empty list if no deleted items exist
